scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @novintix/frontend" "npm run dev -w @novintix/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @novintix/shared && npm run build -w @novintix/backend && npm run build -w @novintix/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @novintix/shared && npm run typecheck -w @novintix/backend && npm run typecheck -w @novintix/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "npm run start -w @novintix/frontend" "npm run start -w @novintix/backend"
